entries.answer:
[ERROR LIST]
1. [line 3 / `ThreadPoolError`] — Broken import: `concurrent.futures` exports no `ThreadPoolError` → `ImportError: cannot import name 'ThreadPoolError'` at startup; the script never executes past line 3
2. [line 6 / `cookie`] — Logic: defaults to `""` when no CLI arg given; an empty `Cookie` header is sent, so `fetch_conversation` receives unauthenticated login/error pages and extracts zero image URLs
3. [line 9 / `target_ids_file`] — Runtime: hardcoded path `/home/ubuntu/upload/Pasted_content_03.txt`; if the file is absent the uncaught `open()` raises `FileNotFoundError` and the script crashes
4. [line 12 / ID regex] — Logic: `r''` matches a literal backslash followed by any character instead of a literal dot; it never matches a real `` URL, so `ids` is always empty and the entire pipeline silently no-ops
5. [line 25 / URL regex] — Logic: the character class `[^"\\ ]` excludes backslashes, so every matched URL is truncated at the first `\u0026` escape; signed URLs lose all query parameters after the first one, producing 403 failures at download time
6. [line 26 / `u.replace('\\\\u0026', '&')`] — Logic: the pattern matches two literal backslashes + `u0026`, never the actual single-backslash `\u0026` sequence, and line 25's truncation already removed it — the replace is a guaranteed no-op; URLs are never unescaped
7. [line 27 / extension filter] — Logic: `r'\\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif)(?:\\?|$)'` requires a literal backslash before any character plus extension; it matches no normal URL, so every extracted URL is discarded and `urls` is always `[]` even when line 25 found candidates
8. [line 28 / `list(set(urls))`] — Logic: set iteration order is nondeterministic, so the `idx`↔URL mapping changes between runs; combined with the line 38 existence check, the same image is re-downloaded under a different index, creating duplicate files
9. [line 35 / `ext_match` regex] — Logic: same broken `\\.` pattern as line 27, so `ext_match` is always `None` and every file is saved with the fallback `.jpg` extension regardless of actual format (png/webp/gif files mislabeled)
10. [lines 38–39 / `os.path.exists` skip] — Logic: a pre-existing file returns `True` and is counted in `success_count`, so line 70's report inflates the "successfully downloaded" figure with files that were not downloaded in this run
[END OF LIST]
